title: Rollback Tool - public implementations survey
definition: Restores a project to a known previous state.
description:
Rollback Tool is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Restores a project to a known previous state. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Rollback Tool. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Rollback Tool. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Rollback Tool capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.

title: Mercurial - related Rollback Tool technology
definition: Clean distributed VCS alternative.
description:
Mercurial is not itself a Rollback Tool, but it belongs in this survey because real Rollback Tool work leans on it. Clean distributed VCS alternative.

In a Rollback Tool build it shows up when startup speed beats raw peak power. Its architecture reflects hard-won lessons: small sharp pieces, explicit contracts between them, and no magic hidden from the operator. Knowing the surrounding technology is part of knowing the capability - the best Rollback Tool practitioners can say exactly where their tool ends and its neighbors begin.

For builders, Mercurial is the pragmatic pick for most builds as supporting technology. The demo program exercises a core idea from its domain - run it with node and watch each step.

t: Rollback Tool review checklist - practitioner discipline
title: Rollback Tool review checklist - practitioner discipline
definition: The review checklist discipline for Rollback Tool: restores a project to a known previous state..
description:
review checklist is the Rollback Tool discipline: Restores a project to a known previous state. It turns Rollback Tool from an event into a repeatable capability.

In practice this means: keep a failure log: what broke, why, and what now prevents it; review the result with fresh eyes before calling it done; declare inputs, expected outputs, and acceptance checks before starting Teams that follow the discipline get predictable builds; teams that skip it get interesting stories. The Signature line prefers predictable builds, and this record's demo makes the discipline concrete and runnable.
